name: Geo Limited
summary: Geo Limited develops and deploys cloud based mobile workforce productivity technologies in New Zealand and internationally. The company offers Geo, a job management software that manages quotes, schedules jobs to staff, tracks job completion, and send invoices for use in cleaning services, locksmith and security, pest control, HVAC/air conditioning, painter, concreting service, delivery and installation, waste management, gardening and lawn maintenance, roofing and guttering, maintenance and repair, electrical, plumbing, and healthcare, as well as builders, carpenters, and maintenance industries. It also provides Geo for Sales, a customizable software for door-to-door sales that offers prospects, schedule appointments, assignment of territories, team geolocation, monitor compliance, dashboard, CRM integration, tailored reports, on-the-spot signup, and offline mode for security, safety, and home services, as well as in solar, retail energy, telecom, construction, and Internet industries. The company was formerly known as GeoOp Limited and changed its name to Geo Limited in September 2018. Geo Limited was founded in 2009 and is based in Wellington, New Zealand.
